lines.text: The LORD tells Moses to lead the people to the land promised to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, but He will not go with them.
When the people hear the bad news, they mourn, and the Israelites strip off their jewelry from Mount Sinai onward.
Moses pitches the Tent of Meeting outside the camp, and the LORD speaks with him face to face while Caleb stays in the tent.
Moses says he will not go up without God's Presence, and the LORD agrees because Moses has found favor in His sight.
Moses asks to see God's glory, but the LORD says no one can see His face and live, so Moses will see His back.
